signals.name: Resilience Alpha
signals.finding: Net cash-flow margin of 44.3% sits well above the industry's 4.0% accrual net-margin benchmark (different accounting bases, so not stated as a direct multiple), and observed payment amounts to both tracked raw-material vendors declined between recorded payments, even as the sector reports a 15.0% material cost surge.

signals.name: Growth Reinvestment
signals.finding: $10,650 (9.5% of monthly revenue) was deployed across three distinct areas -- software (AutoCAD), marketing (local SEO), and equipment capex (a down payment) -- rather than reactive operational overhead. That spread across categories, not just the total, is what separates deliberate investment from a single lucky expense.

signals.name: Expense Velocity Discipline
signals.finding: Core operating expense (Operations + Inventory) moved -2.6% from the first half of the month to the second ($25,100 -> $24,450) -- flat-to-falling, the opposite of the 'high Expense Velocity' pattern the market snippet says banks are tightening credit against.
